source: VVOB Cambodia / MAFF Kampong Thom Provincial Department of Agriculture — IPM and Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for Rice, 9-point training presentation, presenter Mr. Tem Seng, Oct 5, 2010 (training slide deck; no elibrary URL visible)
text: Healthy seedlings ready for transplanting (សំណាបល្អ) should look vigorous with straight, upright stems, no yellowing or wilting, and roots showing active new growth. Farmers are advised to keep bundled seedlings in a clean, shaded, moist place — for example wrapped in a woven basket or banana-leaf covering — to prevent them from drying out, breaking, or wilting between pulling and transplanting, since damaged or dried seedlings establish poorly in the field. Seedlings can generally be pulled from the nursery bed from about 8 days of age onward, though many farmers wait longer depending on variety and field readiness.
